verdict.rationale: The SDK claims built-in context management inherited from Claude Code (docs-1). Subagents run in their own context windows to isolate context from the main agent (docs-4, docs-40), and sessions can be forked into copies (docs-21), so context growth can be contained indirectly. However, nothing in the pack documents a developer-facing way to trim, summarize, or filter the accumulated history itself. Missing for 10: documented compaction or summarization of conversation history, APIs or hooks to trim or filter messages, context-window limit controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
